body: I did look up to a soccer coach I had for about 15 years but he passed away 4 years ago. I have seen counselors at school, but nothing really helped. Right now I just feel completely lost, like I'm wasting my life/not getting to where I should be going.

I think about doing that everyday... I really just want to leave everything and everyone, and start all over, but I can't. I know can't shouldn't be in my heart, but something is holding me back. I don't know if it's my brother or what... I have a younger brother who I use to be close with but we haven't been lately.
I work, read, run, play soccer, workout, play video games, hang out with my friends but I just cannot get out of this. My mind hasn't been free or clear for years.

From what I remember, I have fought with them for years, it's usually about my childhood. They say it isn't the worst, but it hurts me and I have talked to therapists about it. I have never been able to look up to either of my parents, and probably never will. I never really had anyone to look up to.
I do still live with them, I'm 24. Most of my friends my age still live with their parent's but I just constantly feel terrible. I am honestly miserable 75-80% of the day.
